jobs.description:
CAPCO POLAND

We are looking for Poland based candidate.

At Capco, we specialize in management consulting and technology transformation for the financial services industry. We combine innovative thinking with deep industry expertise to help our clients navigate complex change, deliver meaningful outcomes, and build future-ready organizations.

Our culture is entrepreneurial, collaborative, and inclusive. We empower our people to challenge the status quo, take ownership, and make an impact from day one.

As we continue to expand our Cloud and Cybersecurity capabilities, we are looking for an experienced Cloud Architect – Security & Guardrails (AWS/Azure)
to help shape and secure enterprise-scale cloud environments.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled Cloud Architect to provide cloud security architecture services across enterprise AWS and Azure environments.

This role goes beyond traditional cloud architecture. You will design and implement robust defense-in-depth security frameworks
, establish automated compliance guardrails, integrate advanced security platforms, and drive cloud security governance across complex environments.

Working at the intersection of Cloud Engineering, Cybersecurity, Risk, and Security Operations, you will contribute to ensuring cloud platforms remain secure, compliant, resilient, and continuously monitored.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Security Governance & Guardrails
Design, implement, and enforce security baselines and preventative guardrails across AWS and Azure environments.
Develop governance frameworks leveraging:
AWS Organizations
Service Control Policies (SCPs)
AWS Control Tower
Azure Policy
Azure Landing Zones

Ensure alignment with internal security standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

SIEM, Monitoring & Logging Architecture

Design and optimize multi-cloud logging and monitoring strategies.
Build scalable telemetry pipelines integrating:
AWS CloudTrail
Amazon GuardDuty
Azure Activity Logs
Microsoft Defender for Cloud

Enable centralized visibility through enterprise SIEM platforms such as:
Microsoft Sentinel
Splunk

Support real-time threat detection, correlation, investigation, and alerting capabilities.

Endpoint & Workload Protection

Define architecture and deployment strategies for:
EDR/XDR solutions
Cloud Workload Protection Platforms (CWPP)

Secure virtual machines, containers, Kubernetes environments, and serverless workloads across cloud platforms.
Collaborate with Security Operations teams to enhance threat detection and response.

Vulnerability & Security Posture Management

Implement and optimize Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) capabilities.
Establish enterprise vulnerability management processes across cloud assets.
Enable continuous security scanning for:
Cloud misconfigurations
Infrastructure vulnerabilities
Container images
Operating systems

Develop automated remediation workflows and security playbooks.

Identity & Access Security

Design and enforce Zero-Trust security principles.
Strengthen Identity and Access Management (IAM) governance across cloud platforms.
Implement:
Just-In-Time (JIT) access
Privileged Access Management (PAM)
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
Federated identity solutions

Partner with security stakeholders to reduce privileged access risks.

Security Technology Integration

Evaluate, deploy, and govern best-in-class cloud security technologies.
Integrate third-party security platforms including:
CyberArk
Wiz
Palo Alto Prisma Cloud
CrowdStrike
Other strategic security tooling

Drive consistent security controls and operational excellence across the cloud ecosystem.

Required Qualifications

Extensive experience designing and securing enterprise-scale AWS and Azure environments.Deep knowledge of cloud-native security services, controls, and governance frameworks.Hands-on expertise with:
SIEM platforms

Vulnerability management solutions
CSPM tools

AWS Control Tower

Cloud governance frameworks

Advanced Infrastructure as Code (IaC) skills, particularly with Terraform.Experience embedding security controls into CI/CD and cloud deployment pipelines.Strong understanding of:

Modern cyber threats
MITRE ATT&CK framework
Cloud attack vectors
Security monitoring and incident response processes

Cloud Engineering teams
Security Operations Centers (SOC)
Risk, Compliance, and Audit functions

Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

jobs.description:
Aven Hospitality
is an innovative technology provider powered by SynXis®,
the leading global hospitality commerce and distribution platform. We empower hoteliers around the world to exceed expectations, solve daily challenges, and stay ahead of the competition.

With our comprehensive portfolio of solutions, hoteliers can manage distribution, retailing, payments, operations, and more. Providing hoteliers the tools to maximize revenue, improve operational efficiency, and deliver personalized guest experiences that drive satisfaction.

Our tools are built to seamlessly integrate with each hotelier’s unique strategy, elevating guest satisfaction and creating meaningful connections.

We are pioneering AI in hospitality technology to unlock new opportunities, drive efficiency, and personalize the guest experience. By prioritizing stability, scalability, and data-driven insights, we equip hoteliers to adapt and thrive in an ever-changing landscape, ready for whatever comes next.

Aven Hospitality
serves hoteliers around the globe with the industry’s most innovative and comprehensive suite of technology services and products. Our solutions empower hotels and hotel chains to deliver true hospitality reliably and at scale, improving guest experience throughout the traveler journey.

Our team is comprised of the hospitality industry’s most innovative and entrepreneurial leaders, and together we form the fastest growing business unit of a $4B+ global technology company. Candidates who join our team must thrive in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments and be committed to serving the needs of our hospitality customers around the globe. If this sounds like you, we welcome the opportunity to get to know you better.

Position Summary

The Connectivity Certifications
organization at Aven Hospitality (AH) defines and delivers a compelling connectivity value proposition that enables high impact business outcomes for our customers. The team operates in a highly consultative manner, serving as both product and technical experts, while partnering with Sales and Account Management, Product and Engineering teams to design and deliver optimal connectivity solutions.

The Connectivity Certification Analyst
will perform review, testing, troubleshooting and certification of new system interfaces utilizing XML and JSON API specifications for our Property Connect (fulfillment) and Channel Connect (distribution) interfaces to the SynXis Central Reservation System (CRS) platform. The primary responsibilities will be reviewing message formats and system specifications for new interfaces being developed between vendors, customers, and internal staff and providing vendor and technical support for these certifications. The Connectivity Certification Analyst will also interact extensively with our product, development and QA teams and will be expected to participate in technical discussions about integration issues as well as product directions and strategies. This individual should have knowledge in a variety of technical areas including familiarity with hospitality technology standards including Open Travel, HTNG, XML, JSON, reading technical specifications, client and server systems, networking concepts and an understanding of programming concepts and tools.

Key Responsibilities

Facilitate custom API solutions across customers, partners, and internal teams.

Onboard new API connectivity partners and customer, ensuring consistent certification standards and best practices.

Ensure the ongoing success and performance of existing integrations while ensuring adherence to commercially-agreed upon standards.

Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to support new and existing partner opportunities.

Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to troubleshoot integration product functionality, testing and defect remediation.

Deliver customer and partner satisfaction through strong collaboration, transparency, and technical leadership.

Strengthen adoption of the Aven Hospitality Platform by ensuring integrations deliver measurable business value.

Key Knowledge And Skill Requirements

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Proven experience in API quality assurance and certification processes, including functional and integration testing of SOAP and REST services, with proficiency in XML and JSON payload validation.

Experience with SaaS solutions

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Familiar with technical specifications

Strong experience with OTA, HTNG, Opera OHIP and OXI standards is preferred

The individual should be able to work as part of a team or work independently on assigned tasks, and the ability to handle multiple assignments simultaneously

Knowledge of software development life cycle and release process would be helpful

Hotel Operations and Property Management System (PMS), Central Reservation Systems (CRS), Customer Relation Management (CRM) or 3rd party channel experience is ideal

Proficient with relational databases such as Oracle or SQL

Qualifications / Experience

4+ years of API and integration experience

Four-year college degree or relevant experience in a related field

Experience In Hospitality Or Travel Distribution Industry Preferred

Experience working with technical and business stakeholders

Strong working knowledge of Aven Hospitality products and services

Expertise in SOAP and REST APIs

Relational or non-relational database query experience

Outstanding Benefits

Very competitive compensation
Generous Paid Time Off (25 PTO days)
8 Hours of Volunteer Time Off (VTO)
We offer a comprehensive medical, dental and Wellness Program
12 weeks paid parental leave
An infrastructure that allows flexible working arrangements
Formal and informal reward, recognition and acknowledgement programs
Lots of fun and engaging employee development events

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as we progress your application.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum requirements will proceed in the selection process.

jobs.description:
AI & Automation Careers at EY GDS Poland – Power Platform, Copilot Studio and Forward Deployed Engineering

Location: Katowice / Wrocław / Warsaw - 2 days in office / 3 days remote

Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.

Join EY GDS Poland and help shape the next generation of AI, automation and digital transformation solutions. Work with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Agentic AI, Power Platform and cloud technologies while delivering impactful projects for leading global organizations and accelerating your career in an international consulting environment.

The opportunity

With the constant growth of our business and customers’ needs we are continuously looking to extend our organization with experienced professionals. You will work as part of a team that designs, develops, tests, deploys and supports different types of solutions using RPA applications, Power Platform and other digital transformation tools. You will work within a technologically versatile team located in Poland, providing consulting services to biggest market players in EMEIA region and around the globe. 

Power Platform & Copilot Studio Developer

A Power Platform developer with hands-on experience delivering business applications and AI agents using Copilot Studio. The ideal candidate understands enterprise integrations, can work independently with stakeholders, and is comfortable implementing AI-enabled automation solutions in a consulting environment.

Shortlist Skills:

Copilot Studio development
Power Apps (Canvas + Model-Driven)
Power Automate
REST APIs
Business requirements gathering

Copilot Studio Architect

5+ years in Power Platform and enterprise solution architecture, hands-on experience with Copilot Studio and AI agents, strong knowledge of integrations, security, Entra ID, REST APIs, and stakeholder-facing consulting. Experience with SAP, .NET/C#, Azure services, and AI agent frameworks is highly desirable.

Shortlist Skills:

Copilot Studio architecture
Power Platform architecture
Dataverse
REST API integrations
OAuth
Microsoft Entra ID
Enterprise security architecture
Solution design leadership

Forward Deployed Engineer

A highly technical AI engineer/architect with 6 years of experience who thrives in ambiguous client environments and can independently transform business challenges into production-ready AI solutions. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in modern AI platforms, cloud ecosystems, and software engineering best practices while remaining strongly hands-on

 Shortlist Skills:

GenAI delivery experience
LLM application development
RAG architectures
AI/ML Engineering
Data Engineering
Software Engineering
Cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP)
APIs and Microservices
Production deployment experience

Power Platform Developer (Senior)

A senior automation consultant with 4 years of experience who combines strong Power Platform delivery experience with consulting and process optimization capabilities. The ideal candidate is comfortable leading solution delivery and identifying opportunities for process transformation using Microsoft technologies.

Shortlist Skills:

Power Apps (Canvas + Model-Driven)
Power Automate
Azure services (Azure Functions / Logic Apps)
Business process analysis
Process improvement experience
Enterprise integrations

For all roles, we expect:

Strong business English communication skills, both written and verbal.
Ability to collaborate effectively in a global consulting environment.
Stakeholder-facing mindset and ownership of delivery outcomes.

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across nine locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

About EY

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

jobs.title: R&D Applied AI/ML Software Engineer & Engineering Generative AI
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for a software developer with expertise in developing and deploying Applied Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions as well as Generative AI solutions. You will join a skilled, enthusiastic, and innovative global team to create digital technologies to further enhance the delivery of HVDC solutions. In your work, you will combine theory with practice, creating and validating new technologies that can have a meaningful impact on the energy transition.

Our R&D engineers, developers, and scientists develop breakthrough technologies that change the way the world works, and how industries do business. We constantly push the limits of convention, while retaining our focus on delivering quality products and solutions to our customers.

At Hitachi Energy our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation

High-Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) is a key enabler for a carbon-neutral energy system. For over 70 years, Hitachi Energy has delivered numerous technical innovations and delivered many projects. Today and in the future, solutions like HVDC, play an essential role in integrating renewable energy, decarbonizing power systems, and enhancing grid resilience and flexibility.

Join us at Hitachi Energy HVDC Research and Development if you have a passion for research and wish to contribute to the development and delivery of technologies with real purpose. Through your research projects, you will have the opportunity to learn from and contribute to a global multidisciplinary team with a broad range of experiences, both in technology and business processes.

How you’ll make an impact 

Design, develop and maintain software solutions for training, deploying and managing the lifecycle of Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions.
Propose and work on ideas and concepts of new approaches to solving optimization or control problems with business impact, turn them into prototypes and verify them.
Identify, propose, develop and deliver AI copilots and workflows that support engineers in their daily work and bring measurable business value.
Apply state-of-the-art software engineering practices across the full development lifecycle (configuration management, static analysis, unit testing, CI/CD).
Where necessary, development and release of software to integrate specific AI/ML solution into products / tools / processes.
Design data fabric / pipeline architectures to manage data for use in machine learning, artificial intelligence and automation applications.
Collaborate with a global team of researchers and engineers, both within the Hitachi Energy HVDC Research and Development department, and with other teams across the Hitachi Energy organization to identify and solve real-world challenges.
Share your knowledge and experience with other team members.

Your background

Master's degree or equivalent industrial experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering or any related field.
Programming experience in C#, Python and related libraries and tech stacks.
Software engineering expertise across the whole software development lifecycle like design, implementation, testing (unit/integration), code quality, CI/CD, release management.
Ability to conduct all phases of a software project – conceptual work, design, prototyping and verification.
Working with structured and unstructured databases (SQL, Postgres, TimescaleDB, NoSQL).
Experience in architecting performant, scalable and extendable software solutions.
Experience with Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Services to design and deploy AI solutions.
Good knowledge of Generative AI, the underlying models and architectures and associated technologies.
Hands‑on experience applying Machine Learning / Data Science and Generative AI (copilots, prompt engineering) to solve practical problems.
Knowledge of data privacy, IP handling, security for AI tools, and data.
Willingness to take an interdisciplinary approach, working with experts from different domains, and integrating AI/ML approaches into processes.
Experience demonstrating your ability to work in a team, your creativity, and your motivation for self-development.
Excellent written and spoken communication in English.

More About Us

At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive workplace, competitive rewards, and opportunities for professional and personal growth. Our benefits package is designed to help employees thrive both at work and in their personal lives.

Our Benefits Offering For This Role Generally Includes

Private medical care and life insurance
Access to fitness and wellness programs
Access to benefits platform with discounts and perks
Employee Capital Plans (PPK)
Equipment for working from home or allowances for setting up a workplace at home
Spectacles and contact lenses allowance
Company events and team‑building activities
Psychological support program
Free parking available

Add if applicable: additional benefits may apply depending on the role, grade, and business requirements.

You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.

jobs.description:

Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens uppkopplade fordon och digitala mobilitetstjänster?

CGI i Göteborg söker nu erfarna Java- och .NET-utvecklare som vill arbeta med modern backendutveckling hos några av Sveriges ledande företag inom fordonsindustrin.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i tekniknära uppdrag där du utvecklar affärskritiska system, molnbaserade plattformar och backendtjänster som används i nästa generations fordon och digitala ekosystem. Du blir en del av agila team där samarbete, innovation och hög teknisk kvalitet står i centrum.

Oavsett om du har din bakgrund inom Java eller .NET erbjuder vi spännande uppdrag där du får utvecklas tillsammans med några av branschens främsta specialister.

Utveckla moderna backendlösningar och mikrotjänster
Designa och implementera REST API och integrationslösningar

Arbeta med databaser och integrationsplattformar
Delta i design- och arkitekturdiskussioner
Säkerställa hög kvalitet genom automatiserade tester och CI/CD
Samarbeta i tvärfunktionella och agila utvecklingsteam
Bidra till kontinuerliga förbättringar av utvecklingsprocesser och tekniska lösningar

Backendutveckling
API-utveckling
Cloud Native
Microservices
Integrationer

Continuous Delivery

Vi söker dig som har:

Goda kunskaper i Java och/eller C#/.NET
Erfarenhet av Spring Boot eller .NET/.NET Core
Erfarenhet av REST API och integrationsutveckling

God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska

Event-driven arkitektur

Automotive eller andra verksamhetskritiska system

Lösningsorienterad och analytisk
Nyfiken på ny teknik och kontinuerligt lärande
En lagspelare som uppskattar kunskapsdelning
Kommunikativ och prestigelös
Kvalitetsmedveten och ansvarstagande

Därför ska du välja CGI

På CGI får du arbeta i några av Sveriges mest spännande utvecklingsprojekt inom fordonsindustrin. Vi kombinerar den globala organisationens möjligheter med det lokala teamets närhet och gemenskap.

Spännande uppdrag inom automotive och digitalisering
Möjlighet att arbeta med modern teknik och molnplattformar
Kompetensutveckling och certifieringar
Flexibel arbetsmodell
Ett inkluderande arbetsklimat där samarbete och innovation står i fokus
Möjlighet att påverka både tekniska lösningar och din egen utveckling

Godkänd bakgrundskontroll kommer att krävas för denna tjänst

jobs.title: Engineering Manager till Hogia Redovisning & Revision
jobs.description:
Är du en tekniskt stark ledare som drivs av att utveckla både människor och teknik? Vill du leda ett kompetent utvecklingsteam samtidigt som du driver den tekniska utvecklingen mot moderna, molnbaserade lösningar? Hos Hogia Redovisning & Revision får du en nyckelroll där du kombinerar ledarskap, teknikstrategi och innovation med ett nära samarbete med verksamheten.

Om rollen

Som Engineering Manager har du det övergripande ansvaret för ett utvecklingsteam med ca 10 medarbetare bestående av utvecklare och testare. Ditt främsta fokus är att skapa förutsättningar för teamets framgång genom ett närvarande och utvecklande ledarskap, samtidigt som du leder den tekniska utvecklingen framåt.

Du ansvarar för att driva de strategiskt viktiga teknikfrågorna inom området och säkerställa en hållbar utveckling av våra produkter. Rollen innebär ett stort fokus på modernisering, automation och AI-drivna arbetssätt där du tillsammans med teamet identifierar möjligheter att effektivisera utveckling, kvalitetssäkring och leverans. Du följer aktivt utvecklingen inom teknikområdet, omvärldsbevakar och omsätter relevanta trender till konkreta initiativ som stärker både produkterna och arbetssätten.

En viktig del av uppdraget är att balansera förvaltningen av våra hybrida Core-produkter med den fortsatta utvecklingen av våra molnbaserade lösningar. Du arbetar nära produktledning, kravställare och andra utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa rätt tekniska vägval över tid.

Rollen är huvudsakligen strategisk och ledarskapsorienterad, men beroende på situation och behov kan du även bidra operativt i tekniska frågor eller utvecklingsarbete.

Är du den vi söker?

Vi tror att du har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom systemutveckling eller motsvarande samt flera års erfarenhet av modern systemutveckling. Du har tidigare haft personalansvar eller lett utvecklingsteam och känner dig trygg i att kombinera ett coachande ledarskap med tekniskt beslutsfattande.

Du har erfarenhet av moderna utvecklingsmiljöer och molnbaserade lösningar samt ett intresse för hur automation och AI kan skapa effektivare utvecklingsprocesser och bättre produkter.

Vi arbetar bland annat med: C#, .NET Core, Microservices, Azure DevOps, Git, React, HTML/CSS, SQL, Cosmos DB, C++, MFC, XML

Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet av samtliga tekniker, men du har en bred teknisk förståelse och en vilja att fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med teamet.

Som person är du en trygg och prestigelös ledare som bygger engagemang, tydlighet och samarbete. Du är strukturerad och har förmågan att prioritera, skapa riktning och driva förändring även när flera initiativ pågår samtidigt. Du trivs med att arbeta långsiktigt, har ett genuint intresse för ny teknik och inspireras av att omsätta nya möjligheter till affärsnytta. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska och samarbetar naturligt med kollegor, chefer och externa samarbetspartners.

Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Vad vi erbjuder

Hos oss bygger du lösningar som används av tusentals kunder och blir en viktig del av vår resa mot framtidens molnbaserade affärssystem. Du får möjlighet att påverka både teknikval, arbetssätt och teamets utveckling i en organisation som värdesätter innovation, kvalitet och långsiktighet.

Vi erbjuder goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, en hälsosam balans mellan arbete och fritid samt attraktiva förmåner. Vi satsar på hälsa och erbjuder flera träningsaktiviteter, möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån ett par dagar i veckan och en arbetsmiljö där kompetensutveckling uppmuntras.

Hos Hogia får du en roll där ditt ledarskap och din tekniska förståelse blir avgörande för att forma framtidens produkter.

Tjänsten är placerad i Stenungsund med möjlighet till att arbeta två dagar i veckan på distans.

Vi arbetar med löpande urval och intervjuer, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Om Hogia-gruppen

Hogia utvecklar, säljer och supportar programvaror och IT-system för företag som effektivt vill fokusera på sina verksamheter i stället för krånglig och tidsödande administration. Vi erbjuder allt från mindre löne- och bokföringsprogram för småföretagaren till kompletta, branschspecifika IT-lösningar och -system för exempelvis kollektivtrafik, åkerier, godsterminaler, revisionsbyråer och fastighetsbolag. I Hogiagruppen finns 30 operativa bolag, som vart och ett verkar inom ett väl definierat verksamhetsområde. Vår organisationsform bygger uttalat på småskalighet och entreprenörsanda. Företagskulturen skapar engagerade medarbetare. Tillsammans ger vi våra kunder de bästa tänkbara affärslösningarna. Hogia startade sin verksamhet 1980 i Stenungsund. I dag har den privatägda koncernen totalt 650 anställda på kontor i Sverige, Norge och Finland. Mer information om Hogia finns på www.hogia.se.

Vi på Hogia utvecklar och levererar branschspecifika, verksamhetsstödjande system. Vi har mängder av affärskritiska branschanpassade system som underlättar livet, för att inte tala om lösningar inom ekonomi, lön/HR som passar alla, oavsett bransch.

Vi är experter på att göra administrativa och operativa processer enklare, effektivare och faktiskt lite roligare.

Välkommen till en hel värld av smarta branschlösningar!

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide employees in health regions and municipalities with product offerings that help them in their daily work, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.

About Us

Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory- and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

About The Role

The open position is with our DDC PRS product team. We provide personnel- and workforce management solutions to health regions and municipalities. As a DevOps Engineer, you will have a close dialogue with our customers. Furthermore, you will work closely with our architects, developers and application specialists. It is important that you contribute to improving processes and further contribute to us creating solutions that meet the customers' needs and create value for them. We are looking for you who are outgoing, quality-conscious and work in a structured and systematic manner.

Good communication skills both in writing and orally are a requirement.

In this role you will mainly:

Install and upgrade Tieto Workforce Planner with associated applications in internal test environments and with existing and new customers.
Carry out packaging, technical verification and delivery of new versions of the software.
Help move on-prem infrastructure to cloud both internal as well as customer installations.
Contribute to maintaining Workforce Planner in a cloud environment
Improve and automate solutions for software packaging, delivery and deployment of the product.
Maintain and improve technical documentation for installation of the solution.
Maintain internal environments.
Carry out migration of the solutions from old to new servers when customers upgrade infrastructure.
Assist technical operations staff at the customer when necessary.

Secondary you will:

Develop SQL scripts to meet the customer's needs for customized data extraction.
Maintain and improve infrastructure for automated testing.
Testing web service APIs.
Optimize database queries.

It is an absolute requirement that you master both Norwegian and English fluently in writing and orally.

We are looking for someone with:

3-year education in ICT.
Relevant experience can compensate for a lack of formal education.

Experience with:
Azure DevOps and pipelines.
Windows Server and management of rights, certificates.
IIS and configuration of web applications.
SQL Server and SQL script.
PowerShell / bat-scripting.

Good communication skills

It would be beneficial if you also:

Version management systems such as Git.
Container frameworks such as Docker.
Programming skills in C#.
Testing web services with Bruno/Postman or similar tools.
Infrastructure management on Azure.

AI knowledge requirement

AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarizing, analyzing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

What’s in it for you?

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing products beneficial for health regions and municipalities. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, an open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

Could you be our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Svein Johan Hauge, svein.johan.hauge@tieto.com

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses.
We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.

jobs.description:
Job Description

At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide employees in health regions and municipalities with product offerings that help them in their daily work, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.

About Us

Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory- and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

About The Role

The open position is with our DDC PRS product team. We provide personnel- and workforce management solutions to health regions and municipalities. As a DevOps Engineer, you will have a close dialogue with our customers. Furthermore, you will work closely with our architects, developers and application specialists. It is important that you contribute to improving processes and further contribute to us creating solutions that meet the customers' needs and create value for them. We are looking for you who are outgoing, quality-conscious and work in a structured and systematic manner.

Good communication skills both in writing and orally are a requirement.

In this role you will mainly:

Install and upgrade Tieto Workforce Planner with associated applications in internal test environments and with existing and new customers.
Carry out packaging, technical verification and delivery of new versions of the software.
Help move on-prem infrastructure to cloud both internal as well as customer installations.
Contribute to maintaining Workforce Planner in a cloud environment
Improve and automate solutions for software packaging, delivery and deployment of the product.
Maintain and improve technical documentation for installation of the solution.
Maintain internal environments.
Carry out migration of the solutions from old to new servers when customers upgrade infrastructure.
Assist technical operations staff at the customer when necessary.

Secondary you will:

Develop SQL scripts to meet the customer's needs for customized data extraction.
Maintain and improve infrastructure for automated testing.
Testing web service APIs.
Optimize database queries.

It is an absolute requirement that you master both Norwegian and English fluently in writing and orally.

We are looking for someone with:

3-year education in ICT.
Relevant experience can compensate for a lack of formal education.

Experience with:
Azure DevOps and pipelines.
Windows Server and management of rights, certificates.
IIS and configuration of web applications.
SQL Server and SQL script.
PowerShell / bat-scripting.

Good communication skills

It would be beneficial if you also:

Version management systems such as Git.
Container frameworks such as Docker.
Programming skills in C#.
Testing web services with Bruno/Postman or similar tools.
Infrastructure management on Azure.

AI knowledge requirement

AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarizing, analyzing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

What’s in it for you?

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing products beneficial for health regions and municipalities. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, an open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

Could you be our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Svein Johan Hauge, svein.johan.hauge@tieto.com

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med i framkant och skydda vårt samhälle mot cyberhot? Vi söker en Senior Application Security Engineer som vill bli en del av ett passionerat team av cyberspecialister inom vårt Secure Development-område.

Om Truesec – ett ledande cybersäkerhetsföretag

Sedan 2005 har Truesec varit ett renodlat cybersäkerhetsföretag, drivet av ett tydligt syfte: att skapa trygghet och hållbarhet i en digital värld genom att förebygga cyberintrång och minimera deras påverkan.

Genom åren har vi vunnit förtroende hos organisationer världen över och byggt ett starkt internationellt anseende. Vårt team består av engagerade specialister som täcker hela cybersäkerhetsspektrat – med kompetens inom Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond och Recover.

Idag är vi omkring 400 medarbetare – och i takt med att cyberbrottsligheten ökar behöver vi också växa. För att stötta den utvecklingen söker vi nu en Senior Application Security Engineer som vill göra verklig skillnad.

Secure Development

Produkter, applikationer och leveransflöden blir allt oftare måltavlor för hotaktörer, vilket gör säkerhet till en avgörande del i varje steg av modern utveckling. Som en del av Truesecs Secure Development-team hjälper våra specialister inom produkt- och applikationssäkerhet kunder genom tekniskt kodnära stöd, praktiska workshops, utbildning inom säker utveckling och DevSecOps samt längre uppdrag där de blir en integrerad del av team som bygger säkra lösningar från grunden. Med stöd av erfarenhet, egna verktyg och våra tjänster hjälper vi kunder att stärka sitt försvar och säkerställa robusta, framtidssäkra applikationer. Hos oss får du möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad tillsammans med engagerade experter i ett ledande cyber tech-bolag med ett viktigt uppdrag.

Rollen

Som Senior Application Security Engineer på Truesec kommer du att arbeta nära olika kunder för att stärka deras utvecklingsorganisationer genom skräddarsydda tekniska lösningar. Rollen innebär att identifiera sårbarheter i system, genomföra kodgranskningar och guida kunder i säkra utvecklingsmetoder.

Du kommer att analysera kod och arkitektur, ge råd kring hantering av tekniska risker och sårbarheter, leda hotmodelleringssessioner och driva workshops för att höja säkerhetsmedvetenheten. Vi uppmuntrar till kontinuerligt lärande genom löpande utbildning och branschevent, så att du alltid kan ligga i framkant inom cybersäkerhet. Här får du möjlighet att vara med och bygga säkra, motståndskraftiga system – både självständigt och tillsammans med vårt expertteam.

Din potentiella bakgrund

Applikations- och produktsäkerhet är ett brett område, och vi välkomnar kandidater med olika typer av bakgrund. Tillsammans hjälper vi kunder uppnå relevanta säkerhetskrav genom hela utvecklingskedjan, både för applikationer och fysiska produkter.

Du kan till exempel vara en applikationssäkerhetsexpert med erfarenhet av hotmodellering, sårbarhetsbedömningar, kodgranskning och säker mjukvaruutveckling.Kanske är du utvecklare med ett starkt säkerhetsintresse och kunskap inom säker kod, inputvalidering, accesskontroll, molnsäkerhet eller kryptografi.

Om du är penetrationstestare med kodintresse ser vi mycket positivt på din förmåga att identifiera och exploatera sårbarheter för att tydliggöra deras affärspåverkan. Har du även erfarenhet av utveckling av inbyggda system ser vi positivt på kunskaper inom hårdvarusäkerhet och analys av säkerhetsrisker i hårdvaruplattformar. Vi ser gärna att du har god kunskap i både engelska och svenska i skrift och tal.

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av

Säker utveckling och DevSecOps
Mjukvaruarkitektur och design
Programmeringskunskaper i ett eller flera språk, till exempel Java, C#, C/C++, Python, JavaScript, Rust eller Go

Meriterande erfarenhet

Kryptografi, autentisering och auktorisering
Distribuerade system, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes
Molnplattformar (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Hotmodellering och säkerhetsbedömningar
Säker användning av agentisk AI
OAuth 2, OpenID Connect, JWT och liknande autentiserings- och auktoriseringsmetoder
Verktyg för automatiserad sårbarhetsidentifiering
Penetrationstestning
Hårdvarusäkerhet och analys av säkerhetsrisker i hårdvaruplattformar
Sårbarhetshantering
Produktsäkerhetsstandarder och regleringar (till exempel Cyber Resilience Act, CRA)

På grund av uppdragens känsliga karaktär behöver du ha svenskt medborgarskap, medborgarskap i ett EU-land eller ett giltigt svenskt arbetstillstånd.

Bli en del av vår resa mot en säkrare digital framtid

Om du verkligen vill göra skillnad och bidra till att göra världen lite säkrare, då är det här rätt plats för dig. På Truesec får du vara med i frontlinjen i kampen mot cyberbrottslighet i stället för att bara läsa om den i nyheterna. Det här är din chans att bli en del av en spännande resa i ett ledande cybersäkerhetsföretag – och att lära av några av de främsta inom sitt område.

Så, är du redo att teama upp med ett av de mest engagerade expertteamen och bli en del av ett meningsfullt uppdrag? Då ser vi fram emot att lära känna dig!

jobs.title: Senior Developer
jobs.description:
Vil du utvikle løsninger som betyr noe for mennesker - hver dag?

I Twoday skaper vi digitale løsninger som brukes av millioner av mennesker fra helsetjenester og kollektivtransport til energi­styring og offentlig saksbehandling. Hos oss får du jobbe tett på noen av Norges største virksomheter og bidra til løsninger med reell samfunnsnytte. Med andre ord, i Twoday vil du ha en jobb med mening. Vi jobber ofte i tverrfaglige team med moderne systemutvikling, sky-løsninger og AI-drevet utvikling, i et sterkt fagmiljø der samarbeid, deling og medvirkning står sentralt.

Nysgjerrig på noen av våre kundehistorier eller hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss i praksis? Ta gjerne en titt her og her.

Hvem du er

Du trenger ikke å treffe på alt, men vi tror du kjenner deg igjen i mye av dette:

Du har 4+ års erfaring som utvikler innen .NET/C# eller Java/Kotlin, gjerne fra konsulentrollen.
Du har kjennskap til eller erfaring med sky (Azure, AWS eller GCP) og gjerne containerteknologier som Docker, Openshift, Kubernetes.
Du har høyere utdanning innen IT, eller tilsvarende relevant erfaring.
Du er nysgjerrig på hvordan AI kan brukes i praksis, og motiveres av å skape reell verdi på en ansvarlig måte.
Du liker å dele kunnskap, lære av andre og ta ansvar i prosjektene dine.
Du kommuniserer godt på norsk, både skriftlig og muntlig.

Hvorfor Twoday?

I Twoday jobber du sammen med flinke folk som bryr seg, både om faget og om hverandre. Vi er rause i måten vi samarbeider på, det er lav terskel for å spørre om hjelp, utfordre ideer og lære underveis. Trivsel hos oss handler ikke bare om spennende oppdrag, men om å være del av et miljø der folk blir værende over tid. I dag er 35 % av kollegene våre og over halvparten av lederne kvinner. Dette er vi stolte av i en bransje som ofte ser annerledes ut.

Du blir en del av et bredt og inkluderende fagmiljø med aktiv kunnskapsdeling på tvers av teamene i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Finland og Litauen. Vi legger til rette for faglig utvikling gjennom faggrupper, fagkvelder, kurs og sertifiseringer. Hos oss skal det også være mulig å vokse over tid, og å ta initiativ utover eget ansvarsområde. Det kan være innen fagansvar, arkitektur, team- eller teknologiledelse, eller i mer tverrfaglige og globale roller.

Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige betingelser, fleksibilitet i arbeidshverdagen og høy grad av tillit. Du får rom til å styre egen hverdag innenfor teamets og kundens rammer, mulighet for Hive Jumping mellom et av våre kontorer i våre fem land, og mulighet for medeierskap i selskapet. Hos oss skal det være mulig å gjøre en god jobb og samtidig ha et godt liv ved siden av.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Vi tar gjerne en prat, uavhengig av om du aktivt er på jobbsøk eller bare er nysgjerrig på å høre mer om hvordan vi jobber og hva vi kan tilby.

Oppfyller du ikke alle kravene nevnt ovenfor?

I Twoday ønsker vi å skape et arbeidsmiljø der folk føler seg velkomne og trygge på å være seg selv. Hvis denne rollen høres interessant ut for deg, men du ikke kjenner deg igjen i absolutt alle punktene i stillingsbeskrivelsen, oppfordrer vi deg likevel til å ta kontakt eller sende inn en søknad.

Tarkoituksemme on rakentaa parempaa huomista tekoälyn ja teknologian avulla. Tuemme niin yksityisen kuin julkisen sektorin organisaatioita muun muassa energia- ja yhdyskuntatekniikan alalla, finanssi- ja vakuutussektorilla, teollisuudessa, terveydenhuollossa sekä julkishallinnossa.

Suurin vahvuutemme ei kuitenkaan ole teknologia, vaan ihmiset sen takana. Joka päivä asiantuntijamme hyödyntävät osaamistaan, uteliaisuuttaan ja määrätietoisuuttaan auttaakseen asiakkaitamme ratkaisemaan monimutkaisia haasteita ja luomaan kestävää arvoa.

Monimuotoisuus ja yhdenvertaisuus

Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa jokaista arvostetaan ja jossa kaikilla on yhtäläiset mahdollisuudet menestyä. Rekrytointipäätöksemme perustuvat osaamiseen, kokemukseen ja henkilön soveltuvuuteen tehtävään.

Etkö täytä kaikkia vaatimuksia?

Moni jättää hakematta, jos ei koe täyttävänsä jokaista ilmoituksessa mainittua kriteeriä. Meille tärkeintä on, että sinulla on tehtävässä tarvittavaa osaamista, aitoa kiinnostusta rooliin sekä halua kehittyä. Jos tehtävä herättää mielenkiintosi ja uskot voivasi menestyä siinä, kannustamme sinua hakemaan.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
Would you like to build software at the core of algorithmic energy trading? In Algo Core, you will work on a system supporting tens of thousands of trades every day across multiple continents.

We are looking for a developer with experience building production software who wants to take responsibility, contribute to technical decisions, and learn how energy trading works in practice. You will work directly with traders and quantitative analysts, developing the software they rely on.

The team

You will join Algo Core, a team of six developers responsible for developing and maintaining the core algorithmic trading system at Norlys Energy Trading.

We share responsibility for the system’s development and reliable operation. You will take responsibility for tasks matching your experience level, with opportunities to drive work from understanding the requirements through proposing a design and implementing the solution. Designs and technical decisions are discussed with teammates, so you will have colleagues to challenge your ideas and help develop them.

The role

You will maintain and improve our existing system while developing new functionality in C#/.NET. Your work could include:
Building an integration into a new trading venue.
Developing a new trading algorithm that improves a trader’s ability to manage a position
Adding a feature to our trader-facing UI or APIs.
Investigating and fixing an issue in the core algo engine.

Part of the job is understanding what traders and quantitative analysts need and turning that into software that improves their workflows. You will also help to ensure our software and algorithms meet the technical requirements, venue rules and internal governance requirements.

The system runs around the clock, and the team shares a compensated 24/7 on-call rotation, usually one week at a time. You will join the rotation once you are ready to take on that responsibility.

In this role, you will get close to both the technology and the trading behind it. You will work directly with the traders and quants using the system, see where your work makes a difference, and build a strong understanding of algorithmic trading along the way.
– Mikkel-Alexander Vej, Manager, Algo Core

What we are looking for

We are looking for a developer with professional experience building and maintaining production software and wants to keep learning. You do not need to come in knowing the energy trading domain, but you should be interested in understanding the business behind the system you are developing.

Must-have qualifications

A master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science or a related field.
Practical experience with C#/.NET, or substantial experience in a language such as Java and the ability to transition to C#/.NET.
The ability to investigate problems, discuss technical approaches, and take responsibility for delivering solutions.
An eagerness to learn, both technically and about the domain.

Nice-to-have qualifications

Experience with real-time systems, Microsoft Azure or databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Timescale is an advantage.

Familiarity with Python, data pipelines, machine learning, statistics, or the energy sector can also provide useful background for understanding how our systems are used. These are not prerequisites for the role.

What we offer

Responsibility and influence match your experience.
Direct collaboration with traders and quantitative analysts, giving you insights into how your software affects day-to-day trading and profitability.
Opportunities to learn how algorithmic energy trading works while developing your technical skills.
Flexibility in balancing work and home life, while working primarily from our Aalborg office.
An active staff association with a range of social events.

Interested?

If you like the idea of working on software that sits close to actual trading and want to learn more about algorithmic energy markets, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer – vær med til at bygge næste generation af vores digitale platform
jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Platform Engineer – vær med til at bygge næste generation af vores digitale platform

Vi er i gang med at transformere vores teknologiske fundament til en modulær, kanalagnostisk arkitektur. Derfor søger vi en Platform Engineer, som vil være med til at bygge de fælles services, API’er og værktøjer, der gør det hurtigere og lettere for vores stream-aligned teams at udvikle og levere løsninger til vores CMS og apps.
Platformen er et produkt med vores udviklingsteams som brugere og din opgave er at gøre det nemt at gøre det rigtige.

Vil du gerne forandre og være noget særligt for andre? Som medarbejder i LB får du mere substans i dit job, hvor vilkår, goder og fleksibilitet gavner det hele menneske. Hos LB Forsikring lægger vi sjæl i arbejdet, og vi møder medlemmer, kolleger og omverden med skærpet sans. Du bliver en del af et medlemsejet fællesskab, hvor vi er der for hinanden. Vi deler også målet om at gøre forsikring overflødig.

Lyder de her opgaver som noget for dig?

Som Platform Engineer bliver du en del af vores nye platformteam, der både skal bygge nye tekniske byggeklodser og løbende forbedre vores måde at udvikle software på samt optimere og vedligeholde vores udviklingsplatform.

Du vil bl.a.:

Udvikle platformkomponenter som Core API, login, CI/CD og observability
Forbedre udvikleroplevelsen gennem automation, tooling og nye praksisser
Bidrage til en modulær arkitektur, hvor funktionalitet og data er tydeligt adskilt og tilgængelige via API’er
Sikre løbende vedligehold af fælles komponenter

Du får en central rolle i både modernisering af en eksisterende platform og opbygning af et fremtidssikret fundament, som skal understøtte den fortsatte udvikling af medlemsvendte digitale løsninger.

De vigtigste opgaver:

Designe og udvikle fælles platformservices og komponenter
Forbedre DevX, så teams kan levere hurtigt og sikkert fx med automation og brug af AI
Automatisere infrastruktur og deployment
Arbejde med kvalitet, test og observability
Samarbejde tæt med udviklingsteams og omsætte deres behov til konkrete løsninger
Sikre opdatering og vedligehold af udviklingsplatformen

En vigtig del af rollen er at kunne forklare og formidle tekniske valg, så andre teams kan forstå og anvende dem.

Vil du være en del af vores fællesskab?

Vi søger en Platform Engineer med solid teknisk forståelse, lyst til at arbejde med platform og enablement og motivation til at lære sammen med andre.

Vi forestiller os, at du:
Har en solid datalogisk viden og kan arbejde effektivt med både nyudvikling og refaktorering
Har erfaring med softwareudvikling og lyst til at arbejde tættere på platform, arkitektur og udvikleroplevelse
Kan kombinere abstrakt tænkning med konkret levering
Har arbejdet med et eller flere af følgende områder: backend, API’er, integrationer, modernisering, modularisering, automation, IaC eller moderne softwareudviklingspraksis
Er nysgerrig på at forbedre udvikleroplevelsen og gøre det lettere for andre teams kommer i mål
Trives i samarbejde, deler din viden og bidrager til en kultur, hvor man trygt kan stille spørgsmål, lære og udvikle sig sammen
Kan forklare tekniske problemstillinger klart og kommunikere faglige valg, så andre kan handle på dem
Behersker dansk som arbejdssprog, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Vi er i gang med en transformation mod en headless, API-first arkitektur med fokus på modularisering og cloud-native deployment på GCP. Vi er ikke i mål endnu, så en vigtig del af rollen er at medvirke til at drive udviklingen videre.
Vi arbejder bl.a. med Headless Sitecore, React, Next.js, C#/.NET, API’er, testautomation, GitHub/Azure DevOps, Docker, Terraform og GCP. Du behøver ikke kende alle teknologier, men du har lyst til at lære de relevante dele af platformen.

Du har gerne en længerevarende teknisk uddannelse, men vi vægter relevant erfaring, god dømmekraft og læringslyst lige så højt. Vi lægger vægt på, at du møder andre med respekt, stiller gode spørgsmål og bidrager til at skabe klarhed om muligheder, løsninger og næste skridt.

Lyder rollen som noget for dig, håber vi, at du også søger, selvom du ikke matcher alle ønskerne. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, bidrage og skabe gode løsninger sammen med andre.

Hvad kan du forvente?

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor:
Vi bygger løsninger, der bruges hver dag
Vi tager ansvar for både retning og levering
Vi gør andre teams mere effektive
Vi prioriterer kvalitet, samarbejde og faglig udvikling

Vi har spurgt tre af dine kommende kolleger om, hvordan de oplever LB

”De fleste vil sige, at vores arbejde handler mere om fakta end om sanser. Det er også rigtigt i den tekniske problemløsning. Det kræver til gengæld sans for både forretningen og for andre, når der skal vælges, hvad vi løser først, og hvor langt, vi går.”

”Vi kan godt lide hinanden, vi vil gerne hinanden, og vi er der for hinanden. Sådan skal det være at gå på arbejde. LB er et fællesskab, man er en del af – både i ens eget team og med alle de andre herinde.”

”Det giver energi at kunne se formålet med det, vi laver. Det giver en substans i jobbet, når de applikationer, du arbejder på, bliver brugt af andre i den anden ende. Uanset, om det så er digital selvbetjening til medlemmerne, dokumenthåndtering til kollegerne eller noget helt tredje.”

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Hvis du synes, jobbet lyder spændende, og ønsker mere information, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingschef Jean Breinholt på tlf. 31 19 15 25.

Hvis du vil vide mere om rekrutteringsforløbet kan du kontakte HR-konsulent Sarah Sivebæk på tlf. 53 60 73 03.

jobs.title: Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM (frontend/backend udvikler) - genopslag
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
I Clever arbejder vi for en verden, der kører på el. Lige nu har vi brug for dig, der vil være med til at bygge og udvikle Dynamics 365 CRM-løsninger, som er med til at gøre det nemmere for vores kunder at vælge el i hverdagen.

Din rolle

Rollen er en frontend-udvikler med forståelse for backend udvikling. En rolle, der har et ben i begge lejre, som vil være med til at bygge og sætte retningslinjer for udviklingskomponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

Vi drømmer om dig, der vil være med til at bygge centrale komponenter med mange aftagere. Vi arbejder med et system, der er bredt anvendt og hyppigt videreudvikles, så du vil indgå i dialoger med mange interne interessenter. Med andre ord er de rammer, vi sætter i CRM-platform teamet ikke kun vigtige for os, men også for andre udviklingsteams’ arbejde med platformen. Konkret vil du operere med frontend komponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

I dagligdagen anvender vi PCF, typescript og custom pages mv. for at understøtte forretningens processer i CRM.

Hos os har vi ikke klassiske titler. Vi har profiler. Når vi kalder rollen ”frontend-udvikler”, er det, så du og resten af verden ved, hvem vi leder efter. Men når du starter hos os, bliver din profil ”Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM” – for det er netop det, du er.

Din hverdag

Din hverdag vil blandt andet være fyldt med:

Udvikling af React, Typescript-baserede komponenter og custom pages i CRM.
Dialoger om optimal anvendelse af teknologi og principper inden for udvikling
Planlægning af projekter
Monitorering og drift af vores systemer
Samarbejde med fagligt stærke og hjælpsomme kollegaer, der alle har samme mål for øje

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har god erfaring med React og Typescript, og at du har arbejdet med Dynamics CRM før. Du har prøvet at bygge centrale systemer med mange aftagere, hvor du har mærket, hvad der skal til for, at de fremstår robuste og vedligeholdelsesvenlige.

Erfaring med udvikling af frontend-komponenter i Dynamics CRM
Brænder for gode UI/UX-oplevelser i Dynamics CRM
Erfaring med React eller andet frontend framework
Erfaring med integrationer og kommunikation mellem systemer
Erfaring med C# og .Net og forståelse for backend-udvikling er et plus

Hvem bliver dine legekammerater?

Du vil blive en del af CRM-platform teamet , hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen, og derfor primært befinder os på vores kontor.

Vi er seks fuldtidsansatte og en studentermedhjælper. Det vil sige en platforms- og strategiansvarlig, to Dynamics platformsspecialister, en koordinator, en release manager samt vores cloudarkitekt- og backendudvikler. Dine tætteste kollegaer vil primært være i dit eget team, men vi arbejder også tæt sammen med et andet CRM-team.

Derudover er der gode muligheder for at skabe netværk og samarbejde med andre frontend-udviklere i Clever.

Medledelseskompetencer (vi er nemlig organiseret anderledes)  

Du tager naturligt ansvar for både dig selv og dine kollegaer, med omsorg og nærvær  
Du er en holdspiller, der ser arbejde som et samarbejde, ikke en konkurrence  
Du holder dit ego i skak og ved, at succes handler om at løfte i flok mod fælles mål 

Har du sat mentale flueben hele vejen igennem?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Finder vi det rette match, kan vi finde på at lukke opslaget før fristen. Så hvis du tænker, at det her job er det rigtige for dig, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag, så du er sikker på at komme i betragtning. Are You Ready to Play an Important Role in Translating Business Needs into Robust Technical Solutions?

This exciting oportunity involves challenging ineffective solutions, improving engineering standards and contributing actively to architectural and technical decisions. You should be confident to challenge current practices while remaining open to new ideas and methods.

Get To Know Us

The RiskPoint Group is a fast-growing global Managing General Underwriter (MGU), providing specialist insurance solutions across multiple lines of business in close partnership with leading insurance companies.

We are a global company of more than 325 employees, collaborating across borders while leveraging local market expertise in 18 locations. We combine deep underwriting expertise with hands-on, in-house claims handling, and high-quality internal business support, to deliver outstanding service and results to the market.

With us, you are trusted with responsibility. We invest in your development, value initiative, and give you the opportunity to shape your role, grow your expertise, and make a real impact.

About Your Team

Your colleagues form part of our wider global IT team operating across 17 countries with 24 experts internationally. In this role you will work with other IT colleagues in both Denmark and the rest of the world. Our global IT team is an integral part of the wider Finance and Operations Department.

You will join a cross functional IT organization working across development, architecture, data, infrastructure, and business partnering. The team is closely connected to the business and to external partners, and is responsible for both internally developed services and the effective integration of external platforms into the wider technology landscape.

What Will You Do?

As our new Senior Developer you will play an important part in translating business needs into robust technical solutions. The role involves challenging ineffective solutions, improving engineering standards and contributing actively to architectural and technical decisions. We are therefore looking for someone who is solution-oriented, willing to take ownership of outcomes, and able to work independently in a fast-moving environment. Additionally, you should be confident to challenge current practices while remaining open to new ideas and methods.

You will collaborate with architects, analysts, and a variety of internal stakeholders, as well as working closely with external vendors.

Key responsibilities include:

Designing and developing production grade backend services in Golang to support integrations, APIs, and business critical workflows.
Owning and enhancing core shared services and microservices, enabling integrations, workflows, and business automation.
Building tools and digital capabilities to streamline business processes
Designing APIs and integration solutions, connecting platforms, external services ,and business applications..
Working with SQL data structures and service-driven data flows supporting analytics, reporting, and downstream consumption.
Identifying automation opportunities
Contributing to Kubernetes based deployment patterns, Helm based configuration, runtime stability, and service observability.
Building and improving CI CD pipelines focusing on secure, repeatable, and automated delivery.
Using Terraform and related automation to support infrastructure as code and environment consistency.
Owning the design, implementation, and operational stability of end-to-end data flows and pipelines

The position is newly created to support our growth strategy and add further value to the team. You will have the opportunity to evolve within the current position whilst learning new skills and developing your career.

The position will be based in Copenhagen and is office based.

About You

We are looking for someone who is a structured and analytical thinker, and has a pragmatic approach to drive results. Your ability to remain humble is important when collaborating with technical and non-technical audiences across the business.

To be successful in this role, you should have:

A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a similar relevant discipline.
At least 5 years hands-on backend development experience within a corporate or product-based environment.
Strong and proven experience with Golang
Experience designing and implementing APIs and service to service integrations across multiple systems.
Hands on experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure Functions and cloud hosted services.
Knowledge of Kubernetes and container-based deployments. Experience with Helm is required.
Strong experience building and maintaining CI CD pipelines. Practical knowledge of GitHub Actions or equivalent GitHub based automation is highly desirable.
Hands on experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
Demonstrated SQL capabilities and confidence working with database design, data structures, DDL, and data transformations. Experience with PostgreSQL is highly relevant.
Proficiency in JavaScript to develop services, integrations, and supporting tools.
Confidence working in agile delivery environments using Jira and GitHub as core engineering tools.

It will be a strong advantage if you also bring:

Proven capability in C# and .NET development, including building, maintaining, and integrating enterprise applications
Familiarity with integration-heavy environments where multiple business systems and external vendors work together reliably.
The ability to contribute to architecture discussions and translate principles into practical engineering decisions.
Experience balancing speed, quality, and operational stability in a growing business environment.

You must have current residency in Denmark with the necessary work and residency permits in place before applying.

Spoken and written fluency in Danish and English is essential for this role. Other languages are an advantage.

How Do You Apply?

We are looking forward to learning more about you through your CV and responses to the application questions below. Please apply in English.

We wish to receive your application by 16th October. We will review applications on a rolling basis, so encourage you to apply early.

Please note that we do not accept applications via email. All further communication will be in English.

About The RiskPoint Group

The RiskPoint Group is one of Europe’s largest Managing General Underwriters (MGUs), providing best in class insurance solutions to businesses and their advisors globally. The RiskPoint Group operates as RiskPoint in Europe and Asia and RP Underwriting in the rest of the world.

With 300+ employees and 17 locations in Europe, North America, and Asia Pacific, the RiskPoint Group employs expert underwriting and specialized, in-house claims teams within Accident & Health, Transactional Risk, Property & Construction, Renewable Energy, Offshore Upstream, and Liabilities, including Financial Lines, Cyber, and Casualty.

The RiskPoint Group is a Coverholder with Lloyd’s of London and is backed by a strong panel of well-reputed insurance companies. The RiskPoint Group core values are: trust, openness & honesty, respect & tolerance, drive & dedication as well as being part of a winning team in a competitive environment.

Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide ,
we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

The Opportunity: Senior Backend Engineer, Cashalo

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the the team building Cashalo. You'll play a key role in building and scaling the core technology that powers financial access for millions of Filipinos - working on product-facing features, platform reliability, and technical initiatives across our .NET and Azure stack.

This is a high-ownership IC role on a lean, globally connected team. You'll work closely with product, credit, and engineering colleagues across APAC, with a global team to leverage when needed.

This is a 100% remote role that requires travel 2-4 times/year.

How You'll Make An Impact

Build and maintain robust backend services and APIs using .NET (C#) that power Cashalo's lending products
Take ownership of features end-to-end — from requirements through to deployment — working closely with product and business stakeholders
Contribute to platform reliability, observability, and deployment practices on Azure
Help uplift the team through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and a high bar for quality

Why You're a Great Fit

Demonstrated hands-on experience in .NET (C#) building production-grade backend systems
Strong experience with SQL Server — relational data modelling, query optimisation, and schema management
Experience building on a public cloud platform (Azure, AWS, GCP)
Strong fundamentals in designing and consuming REST APIs
A product engineer mindset - you care about solving real user and business problems, not just writing clean code
Comfortable operating with autonomy in a fast-moving, lean team where ownership and initiative are valued
Experience in fintech or lending is a plus

Our Interview Process

Recruiter Screen: A conversation to learn about your experience and what you're looking for in your next role.
Hiring Manager Interview: A deeper discussion with Michael Dove about your background, ways of working, and career story.
Technical Interview: A hands-on session covering technical depth, system design, and coding (.NET/Azure focused, ~1.5 hours).
Leadership Conversation: A final conversation with our senior leadership team about mission, growth, and mutual fit.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Get At Tilt

Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.
Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.
Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.
Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.
Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)
Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

jobs.description:
Job Description

DSO National Laboratories (DSO) is Singapore’s largest defence research and development (R&D) organisation, with the critical mission to develop technological solutions to sharpen the cutting edge of Singapore's national security. At DSO, you will develop more than just a career. This is where you will make a real impact and shape the future of defence across the spectrum of air, land, sea, space and cyberspace.

The Information Division focuses on capabilities and technologies that enable the MINDEF/SAF to harness and exploit information in the physical battlefield and cyberspace. Capability areas include cybersecurity, cryptography, data analytics and fusion, artificial intelligence, vulnerabilities assessments and operations analysis. Our highly skilled Software Engineers architect advanced computing clusters, contributing to enhanced computational efficiency and performance. They work alongside a multidisciplinary team of research scientists to develop full-stack software solutions with novel capabilities in the digital and physical realms. Beyond software development, they also provide expertise in software engineering processes, software methodologies and tools.

People are DSO’s greatest asset. You will get to realise your career aspirations and develop your own niche either as a deep technical expert or a leader in the team. With frequent career dialogues and a robust training and development framework, we will provide you with the necessary development tools for you to reach your potential. You will also be recognised and rewarded through competitive remuneration packages and scholarship opportunities.

Software Engineer (Information)

In This Role, You Will

Work collaboratively with a dynamic team to architect, optimise, deploy, and maintain computing clusters, ensuring high performance and efficiency. Collaborate with data engineers to develop effective ETL pipelines for seamless data integration and processing.
Engage in the end-to-end development lifecycle of full-stack software solutions, from eliciting requirements to developing, testing, deploying and iteratively improving systems to meet user needs and mission objectives.
Design and build modern software architectures that are scalable, resilient, safe, and secure, while providing expertise in software design and programming to research projects. Work closely with research scientists to implement and refine the latest algorithmic ideas.
Put cutting-edge technologies, algorithms, and models into production by designing and implementing DevOps/DevSecOps pipelines, test environments, and simulators for software verification and validation.
Collaborate with research scientists and users across programmes, divisions, and organisations to conduct integration tests in the laboratory and potentially in the field.

Job Requirements

Masters / Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or related field.
3+ years’ experience in architecting and managing large-scale computing clusters.
Proficiency in cluster management tools and platforms, such as Kubernetes or OpenShift.
Strong understanding of distributed computing concepts and technologies such as Apache Hadoop or Apache Spark.
Knowledge of networking, storage solutions and server infrastructure.
Experience in C / C++ / C# / Java / JavaScript / Python / Bash / Powershell.
Well-versed in Object-Oriented Analysis and Design.
Passion to build secure server-client systems.
Experience in software testing and DevOps/DevSecOps will be an advantage.
Interest in any of the following areas: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Data Analytics or Full-Stack Development.
