and contribute to meaningful solutions.

So… What does it mean to be a #Nextlaner?

Be part of a growth-oriented culture.
Collaborate with colleagues from all over the world.
Believe in the Power of ideas and the diversity of thought.
Be committed to provide an environment where you can learn, grow, and collaborate on projects that make a global impact.

Our success is measured not just by results, but also by the growth and satisfaction of those who are part of our company.

At Nextlane, you’ll have the opportunity to innovate
, push boundaries
, and work on solutions that are transforming
the automotive world.

Your Responsibilities

As Engineering Manager for Remarketing, you will lead an multidisciplinary engineering team of approximately eight people, potentially organized across multiple delivery streams responsible for a complex portfolio of customer-facing mobile and web applications, backend services, integrations, quality capabilities, and AI-enabled image-processing workflows. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you will be accountable for team development, engineering execution, delivery predictability, quality, and technical sustainability.

You will partner closely with Product, the Technical Lead, QA, Architecture, DevOps, Customer Success, Professional Services, and other engineering teams. Product owns the vision, roadmap, and the what and why; you own engineering capacity, delivery planning, and feasible execution of the when and how. You will challenge incomplete requirements, ensure work is ready before commitment, and make risks, dependencies, and trade-offs transparent.

This is a technically credible leadership role rather than a full-time coding position. You must be able to review designs, challenge architectural decisions, guide engineers and the Technical Lead, and enter the code or production diagnostics when necessary.

This role requires a change-oriented leader who can improve the operating model while maintaining delivery and production continuity across a complex product landscape.

Key Responsibilities

What We're Looking For:

Team Leadership and Development

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary team of approximately eight people, including internal engineers and external contributors.
Conduct regular one-to-one meetings, provide timely feedback, manage performance, and create career-development plans.
Own hiring, onboarding, capability planning, career development, continuity planning for critical roles, and recommendations related to progression.
Strengthen the Technical Lead role and clarify accountability across Engineering, Product, and QA.
Foster ownership, collaboration, psychological safety, continuous learning, and constructive challenge.

Delivery Ownership and Predictability

Be accountable for engineering execution and delivery predictability across the Remarketing scope.
Translate roadmap priorities into realistic delivery plans based on capacity, dependencies, risks, technical constraints, and operational workload.
Provide high-level estimates and estimated delivery dates, revising them transparently as scope or evidence changes.
Own sprint planning, execution control, reviews, retrospectives, refinement facilitation, capacity planning, and continuous improvement.
Protect the team from uncontrolled scope changes and ad hoc requests, ensuring accepted work is visible, prioritized, and traceable in Jira.
Manage cross-team dependencies, release readiness, and scope-versus-timeline trade-offs.
Use engineering and delivery metrics to reduce carry-over, improve flow, and communicate progress and risk.

Product and Cross-Functional Partnership

Operate under a clear model: Product defines the what and why; Engineering owns feasible execution of the when and how.
Challenge unclear requirements and ensure initiatives meet agreed Definition of Ready standards before commitment.
Contribute engineering input to discovery, functional analyses, RFCs, roadmap feasibility, non-functional requirements, and sequencing.
Partner with Product to ensure that roadmap items are translated into delivery-ready epics, with clear scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risks, and intended outcomes, before Engineering commits to execution.
Work with Customer Success, Professional Services, PMO, Sales, and Support through agreed channels and explicit ownership boundaries.
Participate in customer interactions only exceptionally, primarily for critical technical escalations.

Quality, SDLC and Operational Excellence

Drive a disciplined and traceable SDLC, with Jira as the source of truth for engineering execution.
Establish and enforce Definitions of Ready and Done, release criteria, quality gates, and consistent issue-type usage.
Ensure that the team implements an appropriate automated-testing strategy across the relevant test levels, in partnership with the Technical Lead and QA.
Be accountable for integrating security, reliability, observability, performance, and operability into engineering planning and execution, in collaboration with the relevant specialist teams.
Own engineering participation in incident response, root-cause analysis, bug triage, corrective actions, and post-release monitoring.
Balance roadmap delivery, defects, operational support, technical debt, and modernization.

Technical Leadership and Modernization

Review solution designs, challenge architectural choices, and guide decisions with the Technical Lead and Architecture.
Provide organizational leadership for modernization initiatives, partnering with the Technical Lead and Architecture on technical direction and execution.
Ensure that technical decisions across distributed systems, APIs, mobile and web applications, data stores, integrations, and asynchronous workflows are appropriately reviewed and owned.
Champion SOLID principles, clean and modular architectures, pragmatic domain-driven design, secure engineering, and useful documentation.
Ensure technical debt is understood, connected to business impact, and transparently discussed with Product.
Support the responsible integration of AI-enabled capabilities and external AI services without requiring specialist model-development expertise.

Cloud, DevOps and Production Operations

Lead the team in operating cloud workloads, preferably on AWS, with sound decisions on scalability, resilience, security, cost, and service ownership.
Drive effective CI/CD, infrastructure automation, release management, environment strategy, and rollback practices.
Use logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and service-level indicators to improve system health.
Ensure services and integrations meet the availability, resilience, recovery, security, and documentation requirements appropriate to their business criticality.

Skills

Leadership and Delivery

Strong people management, coaching, hiring, performance management, conflict resolution, and stakeholder communication.
Proven ability to develop senior engineers and Technical Leads and manage mixed internal and external teams.
Demonstrated ownership of delivery, capacity planning, dependencies, release planning, and risk management.
Ability to create clarity and make difficult scope, capacity, and priority trade-offs.
Strong command of Agile and lean principles without treating ceremonies as a substitute for outcomes.
Business-oriented mindset connecting technical decisions to customer value, quality, cost, and operational impact.

Technical Expertise

Strong software-engineering foundation and recent experience leading distributed, customer-facing cloud systems.
Experience with architecture and modernization across APIs, backend services, web and mobile applications, databases, and integrations.
Strong experience operating cloud workloads, preferably on AWS, combined with practical knowledge of containers, CI/CD, observability, security, reliability, and production operations.
Technology-stack agnostic, with the ability to lead environments that may include .NET, React/Next.js, Flutter, and legacy technologies.
Strong understanding of automated testing, quality gates, secure SDLC practices, and maintainable software design.
Ability to lead a team integrating AI-enabled capabilities and external AI services, without requiring specialist model-development expertise.

Language And Soft Skills

Fluent English is mandatory; French is a plus.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
High ownership, sound judgement, and effectiveness under ambiguity.
Constructive assertiveness and confidence to challenge unrealistic commitments or incomplete inputs.
Collaborative leadership with strong negotiation and cross-functional skills.

Experience

A minimum of 8 years in software engineering, including at least 3 years in engineering management or an equivalent leadership role.
Proven experience managing and developing multidisciplinary software-engineering teams.
Demonstrated success delivering and operating complex SaaS or cloud-based products in production.
Experience leading modernization, legacy reduction, or platform evolution while continuing to deliver customer value.
Experience improving software quality, SDLC discipline, automated testing, release governance, and operational reliability.
Strong cloud and modern DevOps experience; AWS experience is preferred.
Experience managing customer-impacting incidents, cross-team dependencies, and critical technical escalations.
Experience in automotive software, digital marketplaces, image processing, mobile products, or AI-enabled products is advantageous but not required.

COLLABORATION AND LEADERSHIP

You will operate as the engineering owner for the Remarketing domain, partnering with Product on roadmap execution while maintaining clear accountability for engineering capacity, delivery, quality, technical sustainability, and team development. Success requires a builder and change-agent mindset: creating clarity, strengthening ownership, improving the operating model, and helping the team deliver valuable outcomes with greater predictability and confidence.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Cloud-Native, AI-Driven Platform)
jobs.description:
Descripción de la empresa

Septeo es un actor europeo líder en el sector del software con presencia internacional, reconocido como uno de los cinco principales proveedores de software vertical en Francia. En plena fase de rápido crecimiento y transformación constante, el grupo se ha consolidado como un referente en la industria del software, impulsado por la fortaleza de unos equipos decididos, audaces y comprometidos.

En Septeo, la inteligencia artificial es el eje de nuestra evolución. La entendemos como un motor de rendimiento sostenible, colaboración e innovación, integrada de manera responsable en las prácticas cotidianas y democratizada en todas nuestras áreas de negocio. Nuestra ambición es clara: «crear software inteligente para Europa».

Nuestra cultura se cimenta en valores sólidos: ser, hacer y transformar juntos. No es una cultura estática; se vive día a día en nuestras acciones y decisiones, logrando un equilibrio entre rendimiento, responsabilidad y disfrute.

Esta ambición se refleja en nuestra labor diaria: diseñar software que acompaña los momentos esenciales de la vida, al servicio de millones de ciudadanos. Desempeñar un papel en estos momentos clave conlleva una gran responsabilidad. Es una responsabilidad que asumimos con orgullo y que pronto podría ser también la tuya.

Unirse a Septeo significa formar parte de un proyecto colectivo internacional, impulsar la transformación del grupo en un entorno de rápida evolución y convertir la IA en un motor tangible de creación de valor, tanto en el presente como en el futuro.

Descripción del empleo

We are building the next generation of AI-native software for the hospitality industry. Our platform powers complex, multi-tenant environments across multiple companies and product lines, operating in high-availability, high-performance scenarios.

Our systems handle critical operational workflows where uptime, scalability, and security are non-negotiable. As we evolve toward AI-native capabilities and intelligent automation, our infrastructure must be resilient, observable, and ready to scale dynamically.

We believe DevOps is not a support function — it is a core engineering discipline that enables product velocity, reliability, and innovation.

If you enjoy designing robust infrastructure, automating everything, and building platforms that engineers love to use, we’d love to meet you.

How You’ll Have Impact

Build the Platform Behind the Platform: Design and evolve the cloud infrastructure that powers our multi-tenant SaaS ecosystem.
Enable Engineering Velocity: Improve CI/CD pipelines, developer experience, and deployment automation.
Drive Reliability & Observability: Ensure high availability, performance, and real-time visibility across distributed systems.
Architect for Scale: Design infrastructure that supports growth, AI workloads, and distributed services.
Champion Infrastructure as Code: Everything reproducible, versioned, and automated.
Embed Security by Design: Implement DevSecOps best practices across the delivery lifecycle.

What You’ll Do

Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure in AWS and/or Azure.
Manage and optimize containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
Build and evolve CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI or equivalent).
Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar).
Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and backup strategies.
Improve monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (ELK stack, Grafana dashboards and alerting, Azure Monitor / Log Analytics, Amazon CloudWatch and other observability tools).
Operate, monitor, and tune Microsoft SQL Server databases (performance, backups, high availability).
Optimize system performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
Collaborate closely with backend engineers (Java / Kotlin, C#, Node.js) to improve deployment patterns and runtime reliability.
Automate operational processes and reduce manual intervention.
Leverage AI-assisted tooling (Claude, Codex, automation agents, anomaly detection systems) to improve operational efficiency.
Participate in architectural discussions to ensure infrastructure scalability and resilience.

You don’t just maintain infrastructure — you engineer the reliability of the business.

Cloud Building Blocks: AWS & Azure

We Run Workloads On Both AWS And Azure. We Are Looking For Solid Hands-on Experience With IaaS And Core Managed Cloud Services On At Least One Of Them — Knowing The Equivalent On The Other Cloud Is a Strong Plus. These Are The Building Blocks You’ll Work With

Virtual machines & autoscaling — Azure: Azure Virtual Machines, VM Scale Sets | AWS: Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling Groups
Virtual networking — Azure: VNet, NSGs, VNet Integration, Private Endpoints | AWS: VPC, Security Groups, PrivateLink
L7 load balancing + WAF — Azure: Application Gateway + WAF | AWS: Application Load Balancer + AWS WAF
Web app / API hosting — Azure: App Service | AWS: Elastic Beanstalk / App Runner
Managed Kubernetes — Azure: AKS | AWS: EKS
Message queues — Azure: Azure Storage — Queues | AWS: Amazon SQS
Object storage — Azure: Azure Storage — Blobs | AWS: Amazon S3
In-memory cache — Azure: Azure Cache for Redis | AWS: Amazon ElastiCache (Redis / Valkey)
Managed SQL Server — Azure: Azure SQL / SQL Managed Instance | AWS: Amazon RDS for SQL Server
Workload identity (secretless auth) — Azure: Managed Identity + DefaultAzureCredential | AWS: IAM Roles (instance profiles, IRSA) + SDK default credential chain
Secrets & keys — Azure: Key Vault | AWS: AWS Secrets Manager / KMS
Transactional email — Azure: Azure Communication Services (Email) | AWS: Amazon SES
Per-environment configuration — Azure: App Settings | AWS: Systems Manager Parameter Store / AppConfig
Logs, metrics & alerts — Azure: Log Analytics / Azure Monitor | AWS: Amazon CloudWatch
Runtime diagnostics — Azure: Kudu / App Service diagnostics | AWS: CloudWatch Logs Insights / SSM Session Manager

Requisitos

5+ years of experience in DevOps / Cloud Engineering roles.
Strong hands-on experience with AWS or Azure — experience with both is a strong plus.
Deep understanding of containerization and distributed systems, with production experience in Kubernetes (required).
Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI or similar).
Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server (administration, performance tuning, backup/restore, high availability).
Experience with Redis in production (caching, session storage, pub/sub).
Strong knowledge of networking, security, and system architecture.
Experience working in high-availability SaaS environments.
Solid understanding of observability, monitoring, and incident management, including Grafana dashboards and alerting.
Automation-first mindset.
Experience collaborating with backend engineering teams.
Languages: fluent Spanish and professional English (both required).

We don’t expect you to master every tool listed above, but we do expect solid hands-on experience with at least one technology in each area
: cloud provider (AWS / Azure), containers & orchestration, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and databases & caching.

Nice-to-Have Superpowers

Experience implementing DevSecOps practices.
Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure requirements.
Experience with cost optimization strategies in cloud environments.
Knowledge of GitOps workflows.
Experience in multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
Hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure.
Scripting skills (Bash, Python).
French — a huge plus (we can dream!).

Why You’ll Love It Here

High ownership and architectural impact.
Cloud-native SaaS platform with real scale challenges.
Opportunity to shape infrastructure evolution toward AI-native capabilities.
Cross-functional, product-driven engineering culture.
International environment with technical autonomy.

Información adicional

Participar en la aventura AI First de Septeo y descubrir nuevas formas de trabajar gracias a la inteligencia artificial.
Crecer y desarrollarse gracias a un itinerario de formación personalizado y a oportunidades de movilidad interna.
Vivir una experiencia humana, intercambiar y compartir en eventos temáticos como encuentros afterwork, actividades deportivas, iniciativas de RSC, seminarios y mucho más.
Unirse a un equipo que cuida de los demás y se compromete con la igualdad de oportunidades, la diversidad y la inclusión.

Mid-Senior level

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
Diseñar una solución de IA no consiste solo en elegir un modelo o conectar una API. El reto está en construir una arquitectura que responda a una necesidad real, pueda escalar, sea segura y llegue a producción con garantías.

En NTT DATA estamos reforzando nuestra Área de Especialización en Inteligencia Artificialbuscamos incorporar AI Architect
para participar en proyectos de IA Generativa para empresas y organizaciones tanto de ámbito nacional como internacional

¿Qué estamos buscando?

Buscamos un perfil especializado en Inteligencia Artificial y arquitecturas cloud
, capaz de transformar necesidades de negocio en soluciones técnicas escalables, seguras y mantenibles.
Participarás en el ciclo completo de los proyectos: descubrimiento y captura de requisitos, definición arquitectónica, construcción de pruebas de concepto, coordinación técnica y acompañamiento del paso a producción.
Nos interesa especialmente que tengas autonomía para liderar iniciativas end-to-end, interlocución directa con clientes y capacidad para combinar visión arquitectónica con ejecución técnica.

¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

Diseñar arquitecturas de IA, datos y aplicaciones sobre Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure o AWS
.
Definir soluciones cloud-native basadas en microservicios, contenedores, arquitecturas event-driven y servicios gestionados.
Diseñar aplicaciones basadas en LLM, RAG, agentes inteligentes y sistemas multiagente
.
Traducir necesidades funcionales y de negocio en diseños técnicos y decisiones arquitectónicas.
Seleccionar modelos, frameworks y servicios cloud según los requisitos de cada caso de uso.
Elaborar diagramas de arquitectura de alto y bajo nivel.
Construir pruebas de concepto y validar la viabilidad técnica de las soluciones.
Actuar como referente técnico ante clientes y equipos multidisciplinares.

¿De qué serás responsable?

Como AI Architect, liderarás técnicamente el diseño, industrialización y evolución de las soluciones:

Definir arquitecturas seguras, escalables, observables y mantenibles.
Diseñar patrones de integración entre modelos de IA, plataformas de datos, APIs y sistemas corporativos.
Construir soluciones utilizando tecnologías como LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, Model Context Protocol —MCP—
u otros frameworks de agentes.
Diseñar sistemas RAG para explotar conocimiento y documentación empresarial.
Definir estrategias de evaluación, testing, observabilidad y monitorización de soluciones de IA.
Diseñar pipelines de CI/CD y LLMOps
para automatizar el ciclo de vida de aplicaciones y modelos.
Automatizar infraestructuras y despliegues mediante Infrastructure as Code
.
Coordinar accesos, permisos, identidades y dependencias en entornos cloud.
Acompañar a los equipos de desarrollo durante la construcción y el paso a producción.
Participar en la evolución tecnológica de clientes, plataformas y proyectos.

¿Por qué nos gustaría conocerte?

Nos encantaría conocerte si:
Tienes experiencia diseñando e implementando soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial y Cloud
.
Has trabajado con al menos una de las principales plataformas cloud: Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure o AWS
.
Cuentas con experiencia práctica en soluciones basadas en LLM, agentes de IA, sistemas RAG o IA Generativa
.
Tienes conocimientos sólidos de arquitecturas cloud-native, microservicios, APIs, serverless, mensajería y arquitecturas orientadas a eventos.
Dominas Python
para el desarrollo de soluciones de IA.
Has trabajado con Docker, Kubernetes, Git, herramientas de CI/CD y Terraform u otras tecnologías de IaC.
Conoces servicios relacionados con IAM, networking, almacenamiento, bases de datos, observabilidad y monitorización.
Tienes capacidad para capturar requisitos y convertirlos en una arquitectura técnica ejecutable.
Puedes desenvolverte con autonomía en la relación con clientes y equipos técnicos.
Has acompañado soluciones desde su diseño inicial hasta su despliegue en producción.

Valoramos experiencia en:

Frameworks como TensorFlow, PyTorch o Scikit-Learn.
Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, recomendadores o series temporales.
Plataformas como Databricks, Snowflake o Microsoft Fabric
.
Despliegue de agentes y soluciones de IA Generativa en entornos productivos.
LLMOps, MLOps y operación de plataformas de IA.
Arquitecturas multi-cloud e híbridas.
Evaluación, trazabilidad y monitorización de aplicaciones basadas en LLM.
Certificaciones de Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure o AWS.
Contribuciones a comunidades técnicas o proyectos open source.
Nivel de inglés que te permita trabajar en proyectos internacionales.

Por qué NTT DATA:

Porque podrás trabajar en retos tecnológicos que no se quedan en una presentación: aquí tendrás espacio para diseñar, probar, decidir y ver cómo tus soluciones llegan a producción.
Formarás parte de una compañía con más de 139.000 profesionales en más de 50 países, pero con equipos cercanos donde compartir conocimiento, pedir apoyo y seguir aprendiendo forma parte del trabajo diario. Apostamos por la colaboración entre perfiles técnicos y de negocio para crear soluciones que respondan de verdad a lo que cada organización necesita.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

En NTT DATA, ofrecemos:
Desarrollo de carrera: plan personalizado y acompañamiento profesional.
Formación continua: certificaciones, cursos técnicos, idiomas, formación en habilidades de gestión y acceso a plataformas de aprendizaje.
Proyectos estratégicos: participación en iniciativas de IA, Cloud y Data para grandes organizaciones nacionales e internacionales.
Tecnología de vanguardia: colaboración con los principales fabricantes y plataformas tecnológicas del mercado.
Equipo especializado: entorno multidisciplinar junto a profesionales de IA, datos, arquitectura, ingeniería y cloud.
Flexibilidad y conciliación: modelo de trabajo híbrido y flexible.
Retribución competitiva: acorde con la experiencia y conocimientos aportados.
Beneficios sociales: seguro médico, seguro de vida y otras ventajas corporativas.

Si te interesa asumir un reto en el que la arquitectura tenga impacto desde la primera conversación hasta producción, queremos conocerte.

En NTT DATA creemos que toda persona es única y diferente y por ello apostamos por una cultura inclusiva que reconoce y valora la diversidad. Trabajamos día a día para crear un entorno en el que podamos explorar, vivir y potenciar nuestra propia singularidad.

We're Capital on Tap 👋

💳 Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier.

Experience in using Agile development practices
A passion for learning new skills and technologies
A proactive, supportive, and collaborative team player

Backend: C#, .Net, .Net Core
Frontend: React, JavaScript

Cloud: Azure & GCP

Interview Process 🤝

Final stage: 90-minute Code Pairing + 30-minute Values Interview

Diversity & Inclusion
🌈

We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work.

Great Work Deserves Great Perks

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer II (Fixed-Term 24 months)
jobs.description:
Luxembourg National Data Service (LNDS)
is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg’s strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation. LNDS enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner. The LNDS service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services. Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, LNDS will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.
www.lnds.lu | LNDS on LinkedIn

Purpose of the job / project

HDAB-LU: This 4-year project, which started in January 2024, aims to develop and deploy the Health Data Access Body of Luxembourg, which is the national authority responsible for granting access to health data for secondary use as set out in The European Data Governance Act (DGA) and the European Health Data Space (EHDS). Its general objective is to enable Luxembourg to establish and deploy services for its HDAB, at minimum:
processing and management of data access applications,
supporting secure processing of health data by data users,
making sure that they are well integrated in the EHDS,
establishing and aligning with EU standards,
and providing cross-border connections for large-scale deployment of HealthData@EU based on the work conducted by the joint action TEHDaS.

As an IT Infra Engineer II, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the company’s infrastructure. You will work closely with the technology team to deliver high-quality services to the HDAB's end users, including data applicants and data users seeking access to health data for secondary use. In addition, you will monitor and report on performance quality metrics and support internal and external stakeholders, including national partners and EHDS/HealthData@EU counterparts, in resolving issues.

What you will do

Help in the architecture, deployment, and improvement of cloud environments, as well as other IT infrastructures needed for the company to operate.
Collaborate across teams to transform business needs focused on public sector data secondary use into secure and relevant deployments.
Implement and ensure that the disaster recovery strategy is followed.
Evaluate and deploy new technologies and tools to keep the infrastructure relevant.
Assist to manage the Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions in place.
Deploy, configure, and maintain servers, storage systems, and networking using different configuration management tools.
Implement effective monitoring and logging solutions to proactively identify and address issues.
Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including system configurations, architectural diagrams, and compliance reports.

Who you are

Masters in a scientific, technological, or engineering discipline related to computer science, information technology, or computing.
2 to 5 years of relevant experience in designing, deploying, and maintaining complex infrastructure environments.
Must have knowledge of automation for the cloud (e.g., Terraform) and configuration of resources (e.g., Ansible, puppet).
Must have solid understanding of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS), security best practices, and firewall configurations.
Must have strong knowledge of RHEL based operating systems.
Must have knowledge of virtualization solutions such as VMware, Hyper-V, and OpenStack.
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python or Bash for automation.
Knowledge of Object-based storage solutions such as Amazon S3, Azure Blob Storage, ...
Working knowledge in cloud computing platforms such as GCP, Azure or AWS.
You have cultural intelligence and diversity consciousness.
Excellent communication skills in English.
Working knowledge of one of Luxembourg’s official languages (French, German or Luxembourgish) is a plus.
Analytical thinker, adaptive, and comfortable in interdisciplinary teams.
Culturally aware, solution-oriented, autonomous, and quality-driven.
